actions.description: Start v2 and verify all endpoints on 8082
actions.command:
systemctl reset-failed rollout-v2.service && systemctl start rollout-v2.service
for i in $(seq 1 20); do
  out=$(curl -fsS --max-time 1 http://127.0.0.1:8082/health 2>/dev/null) && [ "$out" = "ready" ] && break
  sleep 0.2
done
echo "health: $out"
echo "version: $(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8082/version)"
echo "alpha: $(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8082/records/customer-alpha-73c)"
echo "beta: $(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8082/records/customer-beta-a19)"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'missing: %{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8082/records/does-not-exist
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'put: %{http_code}\n' -X PUT --data 'v2-selftest' http://127.0.0.1:8082/records/selftest-v2
echo "readback: $(curl -fsS http…

actions.description: Atomic upstream switch and public endpoint verification
actions.command:
printf '8082\n' > /var/lib/rollout/upstream.tmp && mv /var/lib/rollout/upstream.tmp /var/lib/rollout/upstream
cat /var/lib/rollout/upstream
echo "health: $(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/health)"
echo "version: $(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/version)"
echo "alpha: $(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/customer-alpha-73c)"
echo "beta: $(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/customer-beta-a19)"
echo "selftest: $(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/selftest-v2)"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'put-new: %{http_code}\n' -X PUT --data 'post-cutover' http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/post-cutover-check
echo "readback: $(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/post-cutover-check)"

actions.description: Clean test records and final verification
actions.command:
python3 -c "
import sqlite3
c = sqlite3.connect('/var/lib/rollout/records.sqlite3', timeout=10)
c.execute(\"DELETE FROM records WHERE id IN ('selftest-v2','post-cutover-check')\")
c.commit()
print(c.execute('SELECT id, value FROM records').fetchall())
c.close()"
systemctl is-active rollout-proxy.service rollout-v1.service rollout-v2.service
echo "upstream: $(cat /var/lib/rollout/upstream)"
echo "health: $(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/health)"
